cues: An old music box rattled until a tiny casing screw was tightened before its melody played again.
The nameplate on the antique desk tilted after one small screw worked loose during polishing.
Flat-pack bedside tables waited unfinished while a child searched the illustrated assembly booklet for the next step.
An alpine meadow filled with purple flowers after snowmelt fed the shallow streams.
Autumn leaves gathered beneath a bench as light drizzle drifted through the empty park.
The lighthouse beam swept across dark water while fishing boats returned toward the harbor.
